facts.fact: Expansão reports that Kwik e-money, created by Banco Nacional de Angola and operating since October 2023, is offered by 19 authorised institutions and has about 7.2 million active accounts.
Expansão reports that Kwik lets users of any bank or mobile wallet send and receive money between providers, linking banks and non-bank payment providers.

Expansão reports that Kwik is a single instant-transfer system open to all payment operators, with 16 banks and three payment service providers (PayPay, LinkedPay, Unitel Money) live, though still being implemented.
